claims.content: The Customer manages their account settings by viewing and changing personal details, billing and shipping addresses, payment methods, and email notification preferences on the My Account Page and its linked My Account Edit Pages.
Customer
The Customer is a registered user of the auction site; only registered users may use the auction site (no Guest Checkout).
The Customer's account is active; closed or suspended accounts are not allowed to sign in.
The Customer is signed in with an active authenticated session and is recognized as the expected user via sign-in data or cookie.
The Customer is on the My Account Page, from which the linked My Account Edit Pages can be accessed.

The system displays a personalized welcome message (e.g., 'Welcome, Rick!') based on cookie or sign-in data and shows a 'Not Rick? Sign in here.' link when the current session user is not the expected user.

The system has stored the Customer's account information as entered during registration or subsequently modified, including First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Member Handle, Phone, Password, and Addresses.
The system enforces the invariant that no two accounts may use the same email address.

If the Customer has a credit card on file, the system has stored the card details (name on card, billing address, card type, last four digits, expiration date) and designates one card as 'default' when two cards are on file.

If the Customer has a credit card on file, the system has verified its expiration date at sign-in; an expired default card has been flagged and the Customer is prompted to update it via My Account Edit Page 3.
Before any account information change on My Account Edit Page 1 is permitted, the Customer has entered their current password.
For changing email notification preferences, the system has loaded the Customer's current email preferences on the Change Membership Account Information page (My Account Edit Page 4).
The relevant My Account pages are rendered with the global site header and footer and without Endeca left navigation.

The Customer triggers the use case by navigating to the My Account Page after signing in (via a global site navigation/header link, the global footer link, or the account-related page cluster) and then clicking either the EDIT button next to a relevant section or the 'Change Membership Account Information' link to open the corresponding My Account Edit Page (e.g., Edit Page 1 for personal details, Edit Page 2 for billing/shipping addresses, Edit Page 3 for payment methods, or Edit Page 4 for email notification preferences); alternatively, the use case is triggered after sign-in when the system detects that the credit card on file has expired and prompts the Customer to update payment information.

The Customer accesses the My Account Page, which presents sections for 'My Information', 'My Billing Address / My Shipping Address', 'My Shipping Preferences', 'My Payment Methods', and 'My Email Preferences'.
The Customer views the My Information Section, which displays First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Member 'Handle', Phone number, and Password.
To edit personal information, the Customer clicks the EDIT button/link next to My Information, which navigates to My Account Edit Page 1.

On My Account Edit Page 1, the Customer views the 'My Current Information' section displaying existing First Name, Last Name, Member ID ('Handle'), E-mail Address, and Phone, and enters their Current Password before making changes.

The Customer enters updated information in the 'My New Information' section fields: First Name, Last Name, Member ID ('Handle'), E-mail Address (with a second entry for verification), Phone, and Password (with a second entry for verification).
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button to submit the updated personal information or the 'Cancel' button (red color) to abort the changes.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 1, the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.
The Customer views the My Billing Address / My Shipping Address Section, which displays Address 1, Address 2, Suite or Apt, City, State, Zip Code, and Country for both billing and shipping addresses.
To edit address information, the Customer clicks the EDIT button/link next to My Billing Address / My Shipping Address, which navigates to My Account Edit Page 2.

On My Account Edit Page 2, the Customer views the 'My Current Billing Address' and 'My Current Shipping Address' sections displaying stored address lines, suite/apartment numbers, city, state, zip code, and country.
The Customer may select the 'Same as Billing Address' checkbox above the New Shipping Address data to copy billing details to the shipping fields.

The Customer enters updated address details in the 'My New Billing Address' and 'My New Shipping Address' sections, including Address line 1, Address line 2, Suite/Apartment, City, State, Zip Code, and Country.
The system performs address validation using a Core web service that returns address correction suggestions when the Customer accepts new or edited customer addresses as input.
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button to submit the updated address information or the 'Cancel' button to abort the changes.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 2, the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.
The Customer views the My Shipping Preferences Section, which presents radio button choices for either Standard or Expedited shipping options.
To update shipping preferences, the Customer selects a radio button choice (Standard or Expedited) and clicks the SAVE CHANGE button/link.
The Customer views the My Payment Methods Section, which displays radio button choices for PayPal, Amazon Payments, or Credit Card, with the previously selected type pre-selected.

If Credit Card is the default payment method, the system displays the Card Type, Last Four Digits, and Card Expiration Date; if two cards are on file, both are displayed with one designated as 'default'.
The Customer selects their default payment method (Credit Card, PayPal, or Amazon Payments) using radio buttons in the My Payment Methods Section.

To edit payment methods, the Customer accesses My Account Edit Page 3 by clicking the EDIT button/link next to My Payment Methods, or, if the system detected an expired credit card at sign-in, by clicking 'Yes, Update Now' on the sign-in prompt.

On My Account Edit Page 3, the Customer views the 'My Current Payment Method' section, which displays radio buttons for the previously chosen method (PayPal, Amazon, or credit cards) and, if a credit card was chosen, shows the name on card, billing address, card type, last four digits, and expiration date.
If the Customer has credit cards on file, they may select the checkbox labeled 'Delete this card from this account' next to each card entry.
The Customer selects a radio button in the 'My New Payment Method' section to choose between PayPal, Amazon, or credit cards.

If the Customer is a returning winner using PayPal or Amazon PMTS, the system directs the Customer to a specific page for managing these payment methods (Section 6.13), distinct from the standard credit card management flow.
If the Customer chooses Credit Card, they enter the new card type (V/MC/D/Amex), the new card number, and the expiration date in the provided fields; the system does not store the card security code.
Upon entering credit card information, the Customer receives a billing address warning stating that the account must match the address on the credit card account.
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button to submit the updated payment method information or the 'Cancel' button to abort the changes.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 3, the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.
The Customer views the My Email Preferences Section, which displays a link to My Email Preferences on My Account Edit Page 4.
To update email preferences, the Customer clicks the link in the My Email Preferences Section, which navigates to My Account Edit Page 4.

The Customer manages email notification preferences by checking or unchecking boxes for 'notify me via email when I am outbid', 'notify me when I win an auction', and 'notify me when my winnings are shipped'.
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button to submit the updated email preferences or the 'Cancel' button to abort the changes.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 4, the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.

Diverges from Step 6: On My Account Edit Page 1 (Personal Details), instead of saving changes, the Customer clicks the red 'Cancel' button; the system aborts the update and returns the Customer to the My Account Page without saving any modifications.

Diverges from Step 14: On My Account Edit Page 2 (Addresses), instead of saving changes, the Customer clicks the 'Cancel' button; the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page without applying address validation or saving any modifications.

Diverges from Step 21: At the sign-in prompt for an expired credit card, instead of clicking 'Yes, Update Now' to access My Account Edit Page 3, the Customer declines the update by selecting 'No' or 'I'll do it later'; the system does not direct the Customer to My Account Edit Page 3 and instead returns the Customer to the home page or allows the Customer to proceed without updating.

Diverges from Step 24: In the 'My New Payment Method' section on My Account Edit Page 3, instead of selecting a payment method radio button, the Customer clicks the link to sign up for a free PayPal account; the system opens www.paypal.com in a separate window or browser instance.

Diverges from Step 24: In the 'My New Payment Method' section on My Account Edit Page 3, instead of selecting a payment method radio button, the Customer clicks the link regarding Amazon Payments; a new browser session opens and takes the Customer to the Amazon Payments website to register for a new account.

Diverges from Step 28: On My Account Edit Page 3 (Payment Methods), instead of saving changes, the Customer clicks the 'Cancel' button; the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page without updating payment method information.

Diverges from Step 32: On My Account Edit Page 4 (Email Preferences), if the Customer's default payment method is PayPal or Amazon Payments, the 'Please notify me when I win an auction' checkbox is grayed out and cannot be de-selected; as a result, the Customer cannot opt out of 'winner' emails.

Diverges from Step 33: On My Account Edit Page 4 (Email Preferences), instead of saving changes, the Customer clicks the 'Cancel' button; the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page without saving any modifications.

Exception at main-flow Step 1 entry (accessing the My Account Page): If the Customer's account is closed or suspended, the system prevents sign-in/access to the My Account Page and its linked My Account Edit Pages and displays the popup message: 'We're sorry, this account has been closed [suspended]. If you believe this is an error, please call or email Customer Care at (800) 123-4567 or Auctions@jtv.com.' Exit: use case terminates.

Exception at main-flow Step 4 (entering current password on My Account Edit Page 1): If the Customer attempts to change personal details without first entering their current password, the system blocks modification of the personal details and requires the current password to be provided before any changes can be made. Exit: return to main-flow Step 4 until the current password is entered; if the Customer chooses to cancel, go to Alternative Flow Step 1.

Exception at main-flow Step 13 (address validation): If the Core web-service address validation determines that the Customer's new or edited billing/shipping address is invalid/incomplete or requires correction, the system presents address correction suggestions and does not accept the submitted address until the Customer accepts a corrected address. Exit: after the corrected address is accepted, resume at main-flow Step 14.

Exception at main-flow Step 21 entry (payment-method update entry): If the default payment method is a credit card on file and its expiration date is expired, the system interrupts entry into payment-method editing by displaying a DIV layer / modal dialog with the message: 'The credit card information we have on file has expired. Would you like to update it now?' and options 'Yes, update now' (green) and 'I'll do it later' (red). If the Customer selects 'Yes'/'Yes, update now', the flow enters main-flow Step 21, accesses My Account Edit Page 3, and resumes at main-flow Step 22. If the Customer selects 'No' (DIV-layer variant), the system returns the Customer to the home page and grays out the page; if the Customer selects 'I'll do it later' (modal variant), the system does not redirect to My Account Edit Page 3 and allows the Customer to proceed without updating payment information. Exit: resume at Step 22, or terminate/continue without updating if declined.

Exception at main-flow Step 27 (credit card billing-address validation): If the billing address entered with the credit card information does not match the address on the credit card statement, the system displays a warning that the billing address information must be entered exactly as it appears on the credit card statement to avoid delays in processing. Exit: the Customer corrects the billing address to match and resumes at main-flow Step 28.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 1 (Personal Details), the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.

If changes are saved on My Account Edit Page 1, the updated First Name, Last Name, Member Handle, Email Address, Phone number, and Password are stored and displayed in the 'My Information' section on the My Account Page.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 2 (Billing/Shipping Addresses), the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.

If changes are saved on My Account Edit Page 2, the updated Billing and Shipping Address fields (Address 1, Address 2, Suite/Apt, City, State, Zip Code, Country) are stored and displayed in their respective sections on the My Account Page as validated and corrected address data.
If the Customer selected the 'Same as Billing Address' checkbox during the address update, the Shipping Address is set to identical values as the Billing Address.

If changes are saved via the 'SAVE CHANGE' button in the My Shipping Preferences Section, the selected shipping option (Standard or Expedited) is stored as the Customer's shipping preference for credit card orders.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 3 (Payment Methods), the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.

If changes are saved on My Account Edit Page 3, the selected default payment method (PayPal, Amazon Payments, or Credit Card) and associated card details (if applicable) are stored and displayed in the 'My Payment Methods' section on the My Account Page; the newly selected or updated payment method is designated as default (if applicable), and expired cards are removed if deleted.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 4 (Email Preferences), the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page.

If changes are saved on My Account Edit Page 4, the updated email notification settings (outbid, win, and shipped notifications) are stored and applied to the Customer's account; checkbox states are persisted according to the Customer's selection, except that PayPal/Amazon Payments users cannot deselect 'winner' notifications.
Upon cancellation of any edit operation on My Account Edit Pages 1–4, the system returns the Customer to the My Account Page without modifying stored account data, preserving the pre-edit state.

After the Customer clicks 'Yes, update now' in response to the expired credit card prompt at sign-in and successfully completes the update on My Account Edit Page 3, the expired card is replaced or updated with valid expiration data.
If the Customer chooses 'I'll do it later' when prompted about an expired credit card, the expired card remains on file, but the session continues normally without blocking access to the account.
Edits to user data (Personal Information and Addresses) are persisted in the system via the My Account Edit pages.
